bullets.text: Q2 companywide CR 96.5; Personal Lines CR 96.2 (+11 points YOY); Commercial Lines CR 92.0; Property CR 116.6; YTD CR was 93; June CR was 100.5, the first monthly CR over 100 since August 2017.

Personal auto accident frequency rose 47% YOY, and VMTs increased 20%; collision severity increased with rising used-vehicle valuations inflating repair and total-loss costs; 17 industry-defined weather events added 25 points to Property CR.

Personal auto rate changes were ~2% in aggregate, with increases averaging ~5% across 11 states; homeowner rates rose ~4% countrywide in Q2 (~6% YTD); tightened underwriting where losses indicated rate inadequacy.

Companywide NPW grew 13% YOY; Commercial Lines NPW rose 66%, including Protective Insurance and driven by trucking strength and economic drivers; Personal Lines NPW rose 6%; Property NPW increased 15% to $591M.

Companywide PIFs grew 11%; Personal Lines PIFs rose 10%; YOY growth in multi-product households through June increased 18%, outpacing monoline products; auto and home bundlers ('Robinsons') are a primary focus.

Investment portfolio total return was 1.7% in Q2 with strong fixed-income and equity performance; reduced non-Treasury fixed-income allocation over valuation concerns; maintained duration even at lower Treasury yield levels.

Re-evaluated media budget and reduced spend in certain areas based on target performance; deployed propensity modeling and external home-purchase data triggers to market additional protection offers to existing customers.
Auto 8.6 model deployed to 22 states; 8.7 launched in 10 states; commercial auto 8.0 live in 15 states; BOP footprint expanded to 22 states with 35 targeted by year-end.

Reaffirms commitment to 96 calendar-year CR goal publicly stated for 50 years; emphasized that profit trumps growth as a core value, acting delicately and surgically to reach goals and retain customers.
Plans to hire up to 6,400 employees through year-end 2021, including ~5,900 in claims and contact centers; held annual Inclusion Week in June focused on the power of allyship.
